name: Cheesy Tater Tot, Bacon & Bell Pepper Frittata with Ketchup (Kid-Friendly)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry bell pepper. Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and small dice.

When the oven is heated, transfer tater tots to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake, tossing once, until golden brown and crispy, about 20 minutes (or cook according to package instructions).
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (907 g) bag tater tots or puffs, frozen

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add bell pepper and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until bell pepper is golden and tender, 6-8 minutes.
While the bell pepper is cooking, place eggs, salt, and paprika in a large bowl, then whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
½ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: When the bell pepper is done, reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
When the tots are done, remove from oven. Change the oven to broil on high.

Top frittata with an even layer of tater tots, then sprinkle cheese and crispy bacon over top. Place skillet in the oven and broil until the eggs are set and cheese is melted and bubbly, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Drizzle with ketchup and enjoy!
